jobs.title: Senior Loss Prevention Lead & Field Trainer
jobs.description:
PAQ, Inc. is seeking a Senior Loss Prevention Officer to lead loss prevention activities, supervise LP staff, and ensure secure operations across store locations in Texas.

The role emphasizes leadership, rapid decision-making, and collaboration with management and law enforcement. Ideal candidates will have 5+ years in retail loss prevention, a valid driver’s license, and proven ability to onboard and train agents.
